name: expenses-backend-server
description: Backend database server for Personal Expense Tracker

scripts.sync-android: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); ['index.html', 'app.js', 'styles.css', 'db.json', 'manifest.json', 'sw.js'].forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f, path.join('android/app/src/main/assets', f))); console.log('Synced web assets to android app assets directory!');"
